acceptanceCriteria: A live Playwright run on a real installed toolchain exercises --keep-reporters with list, html, json and junit project reporters, default and environment-named output paths, and a failing test; logs and receipts are retained.
The run verifies that the injected configDir override is honoured and records the observed FullConfig.reporter shape; a mismatch is fixed or becomes a stated refusal.
Only after that evidence may keep-mode receipts project passing (PWP-V0-010..013 amended with the evidence); until then they keep abstaining.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator from the V1-0986 lane (GitHub beamfall/corvint#670).

State: corvint-js-test-provider --keep-reporters (branch claude/v1-0986-gh670-playwright-keep-reporters, commits b910d953 and 12972eb7, batch C) keeps project reporters, but its receipts abstain like /2 because no live run was possible: node_modules was hollow and the lane installed nothing. Codex review P2: default and environment-named reporter outputs are pointed at the project through an injected configDir, and whether Playwright honours that override is unverified offline. Orchestrator decisions: ship the flag with abstention; the provider reporter's position in the list and the low-entropy optionsDigest stay as implemented pending this qualification; the profile-revision exception stays proposed (owner acceptance).
